$schema_note: Six live slots per direction: palette, composition, typePosture, markTreatment, imagery, voice. Motion is deliberately absent as a seventh slot — the Ulysses corpus (130 stills) has no motion material, so a motion direction would be invented, not derived. Shipped hover values are a floor applied to every direction, not a per-direction choice. See ../SKILL.md for the full rule.

sharedInvariants.accent: exactly one accent color per direction; never a large-area background
sharedInvariants.planeSeparation: 1px hairline and tone only; no boxes, no elevation, no drop shadows
sharedInvariants.space: active — rank by interval, never fill a gap because it exists
sharedInvariants.valuesStated: every spacing/timing/size/colour that matters is written down, not implied

hover.note: floor, not a direction axis — provenance: inherited from shipped code
hover.primaryButton: accent fill rises from below, translateY(101% -> 0), no glow
hover.rule: hover never introduces a second primary action

sharedInvariants.contrastFloor: 4.5:1 under 18px, 3:1 at 18px+, measured against the actual backdrop, not the page background
sharedInvariants.greyscaleTest: hierarchy must survive greyscale with motion off

directions.thesis: It says less than it knows.

palette.vocabulary: derive-from-photograph; neutral base + exactly one accent

directions.composition: asymmetric 7/5 split; oversized headline against one dominant photograph
directions.markTreatment: chosen slowly — rejected attempts kept visible at reduced weight with the reason each was dropped

voice.language: concrete, material — matter, grain, ink, hand
voice.rhythm: longer than efficient; ends on the quiet word
voice.formality: first person plural; warm, not familiar

spacing.note: two known exceptions on the base step: Hero 112, Material-Palette 80 — compositional, not errors

directions.thesis: No adjective that cannot be measured.

palette.vocabulary: monochrome base derived from a single hue; exactly one accent, appearing fewer than 5 times, never a background

directions.composition: gridded — visible modular grid, rules and tick marks as aesthetic, numbered reading order (01, 02, 03...)

typePosture.weightsNote: measured, not the two earlier-declared-wrong counts (twelve / three) — four is what the board actually uses

directions.markTreatment: systematic permutation — 24-cell grid shown, one selected; process is the proof
directions.imagery: none — a deliberate departure from the imagery principle, flagged not hidden

voice.rhythm: short; fragments allowed; three beats then stop

spacing.note: declared 4/8/16/32/64/128 was wrong; 128 unused, six values used and undeclared — this is the corrected, measured scale

directions.pole: synthesis (not a third pole) — systematic cataloguing of specimen + the photograph-led restraint of quiet-instrument
directions.thesis: It records. It does not persuade.
directions.composition: measured — spec table + legibility ladder; catalogued, dated, numbered entries
directions.markTreatment: measured, not chosen or permuted — gold measurement rules, an 8-row spec table, a legibility ladder naming where the mark stops working (20px passes, 14px fails -> use wordmark)
directions.imagery: yes — technical, catalogued; no lifestyle photography

voice.formality: high; no contractions; dated and numbered

spacing.note: baseline matrix; two off-scale values (6, 14) are Chief's own and were deliberately left alone

directions.knownIssue: hero copy claims '11 SECTIONS // SECURED'; board has 8 sections — stale claim, not yet corrected as of this file's writing

provenance: Every value above is transcribed from Project_Odysseus/ULYSSES-GUIDELINES.md (§3) and the grounding-audit.md contrast/spacing corrections, not re-derived. If those source files change, re-transcribe rather than hand-edit both places.
